paragraphs: Dr Danae Lim (Dr Chee Zhen Lim) is a cosmetic doctor (ABN: 94 636 002 640) (MED0001188982) with particular interest in Asian aesthetics. She has more than 20 years of clinical experience and is a graduate of the University of Sydney, first training with the Hunter New England Area Health Service, later moving on to the Greater Southern Area Health Service as an emergency medical officer before undergoing extensive training in cosmetic medicine.

Passionate about studying the natural beauty of individuals, Dr Lim enjoys full consultation regarding the ageing processes, skincare and the use of aesthetic medical modalities, including but not limited to energy-based devices, contouring procedures and thread lifts, performing all treatments personally. Another of Dr Lim's area of interest is non-surgical hair regrowth treatments and she is an experienced consultant for the Bioscor International Group. She has also released her own line of cosmedical products with added interest in fragrance development.

Dr Lim is a patient advocate, holds regular educational seminars on public health issues and cosmetic medicine, and was the co-founder of the Australasian College of Asian Aesthetics. She is also a Bioscor Trusted Partner for hair regrowth treatments, a consultant speaker for Galderma Australia, Candela Medical, Crown Aesthetics/Advanced Skin Technology respectively, an accredited MINT thread lift national trainer, national trainer for Inmode Australia and a clinical trial investigator.
